# Browser-local libraries

- `astar-0.4.1.js`: javascript-astar 0.4.1, https://github.com/bgrins/javascript-astar (MIT; see astar-LICENSE.txt).
- `chart-4.4.8.js`: Chart.js 4.4.8 UMD distribution, https://www.chartjs.org/ (MIT; see chart-LICENSE.md).

Downloaded unchanged from the corresponding pinned npm distributions through jsDelivr. These scripts are served locally; warehouse data is not sent to a CDN. Check upstream notices and run routing/chart integration tests before upgrading.
